annotations.title: List the runs on your account

description: Lists the runs on your Neumann account, the most recently started first. Every run made with an account is kept and listed here: run_monte_carlo_simulation (inline or by graph_id), rank_inputs_by_impact and summarize_outcome_scenarios runs alike. Use this when the user refers to a result from earlier and you do not have its run_id, for example after the conversation that made it has ended. Pass graph_id to list only the runs of one saved model, or kind to list only one kind of run. It returns one entry per run with its run_id, its kind, the saved model it came from (none for a model passed inline), its status, when it started and finished, how many trials it ran and, for a simulation, one median to tell runs apart, plus next_offset when there are more to page through. To read a run's results, pass its run_id to get_simulation_results. It lists runs, not models (that is list_graphs), and not deleted runs (that is list_deleted). A run made without an account is not listed. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Example: {"limit":20,"offset":0} Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.

graph_id.description: Optional. A saved model's graph_id, to list only its runs. Omit it to list every run on your account.
graph_id.title: Graph Id

kind.description: Optional. Only runs of one kind: simulation (run_monte_carlo_simulation), sensitivity (rank_inputs_by_impact) or scenarios (summarize_outcome_scenarios). Omit it for every kind.
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: How many runs to return, most recently started first.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: How many runs to skip, for paging. Use the next_offset the previous call returned.
offset.title: Offset
